title: R69: MFU push on RTX 5090 - component A/B, kernel census, optimizer amortization
shape: d12 bf16, b=16 x seq=1024, graph replay + optimizer outside the graph
protocol: same-session interleaved A/B (one process per env config, rounds alternate, medians). 3-step eager-vs-graph parameter parity 0.0 in every accepted run. For torch 2.12.1 the graph is captured BEFORE any eager backward, with torch.autograd.grad ('grad mode') warm-up+capture on one side stream: 2.12 lacks set_override_stale_capture_stream and a prior .backward() makes the full-model capture fail with cudaErrorStreamCaptureImplicit.

ce_chunk_4k_16k.note: no effect on top of the combined config

round4_stack_and_optimizer.best1_note: the `best1` entry in this JSON mixes round-4 (`best`, 58.14 ms) and round-5 (`best1`, 60.56 ms); deltas below use the round-4 same-round baseline 58.14
round4_stack_and_optimizer.stack_note: best1 (58.14 ms) already contains mHC_V4+MOE_LAYOUT=fast+ATTN_DKV_BF16; the stacked estimate applies only the round-4 DWS_INLINE (-1.63%) and MOE_TILE (-0.91%) wins, and -2.41% for 4x accumulation (round-5 same-round measurement)

round5_gradient_accumulation.note: amortizes the 4.39 ms optimizer over K micro-batches; effective batch K x 16K tokens

final_clean_round.host_note: this round ran on a ~3% slower host state than round 1-2 (base 61.64 vs 59.90 ms); same-round ratios are authoritative

kernel_census.takeaway: head 13.77 + attention ~6.2 + mHC ~6.8 + MoE ~9.5 + small GEMMs ~6.6 + elementwise/copy/sort ~4.4; head GEMMs already at ~83% of fp8 peak, so remaining slack is bandwidth-bound elementwise / mHC / optimizer

shape_sweep.note: shorter seq slightly faster per token but not adopted (training seq 1K-4K)

numerics.note: accepted deltas stay in the bf16 training-noise class (R56/R63 precedents 7e-5..1e-4); accumulation changes the effective batch so its loss is not comparable to base

gpu: 3-step eager-vs-graph parity 0.0 in every accepted A/B run

verdict: accept R69 env: measured same-round -4.64% step; +4x grad accumulation -2.4%/token. Measured 278.7k tok/s (56.4% MFU) on the slow-host round and 285.9k tok/s (57.9% MFU) with accumulation; on the faster host state the stacked estimate is ~56.7 ms / 289.2k tok/s / 58.5% MFU, or ~55.3 ms / 296.3k tok/s / 59.9% MFU with accumulation.

torch214_upgrade.why: R69 measured on the image's torch 2.12.1; the R50/R63 reference stack (and the W2 protocol in docs/benchmarks.md) is torch 2.14.1+cu130. Installed the known-good stack into a side venv (tools/setup_torch214.sh) and re-ran the A/B on the SAME host/GPU.

stack.tilelang: 0.1.15 (reused from the image's base env via venv --system-site-packages)

same_host_2x2.protocol: 2 rounds interleaved, one process per config, 3-step parity 0.0 in all runs; final_env.sh carries the R69 block, so the `base` arm explicitly unsets the six R69 vars (NANOV41_MHC_V4/V4_MODE/MOE_LAYOUT/ATTN_DKV_BF16/MOE_DWS_INLINE/MOE_TILE)

eager_step_ms.note: eager host-side cost is unchanged; the win is device-side

head_to_head_with_r69_flags.note: separate interleaved matrix (tc_*.json) where final_env already carried the R69 block; both arms are the full R69 env, so this is the pure torch-version effect

accum4.note: 4x gradient accumulation (effective batch 64K tokens) amortizes the 4.39 ms optimizer

torch214_upgrade.capture_note: torch 2.14.1 has torch.autograd.graph.set_override_stale_capture_stream (the harness prints `override API: True`); the capture-first grad-mode recipe still works unchanged (capture: PASS). Future harnesses may switch back to capturing after the eager baseline on 2.14.

device_census.note: new-env census on the R69 config; comparable old-env census (step 58.68 / device 56.27 / 2857 kernels) was on a different host state

gpu: tests/test_fast_attn_v3.py + tests/test_moe_fast_layout.py: 2 passed under torch 2.14.1 + triton 3.8.0

torch214_upgrade.verdict: UPGRADE ACCEPTED: torch 2.14.1+cu130 is -0.5% on the plain base config and -1.9% on the R69 config on the same host (device-side only), -2.15% with 4x accumulation. Production stack = torch 2.14.1 + R69 flags + 4x accumulation: 55.83 ms per 16K tokens = 293.5k tok/s / 59.4% raw bf16-MFU (best non-accum 57.5 ms / 284.9k / 57.6%). 100B-token pretraining: 94.7 h = 3.94 d ≈ ¥265 at ¥2.8/h.
